name: green-claude
description: Plugins de l'Institut du Numérique Responsable pour Claude Code : écoconception et sobriété numérique (Green Claude), détection des anti-patterns de performance (Perf Sentinel). / Responsible digital plugins for Claude Code by the Institut du Numérique Responsable.

plugins.name: green-claude
plugins.description: Applies 287 eco-design rules (RGESN 2024, GR491, W3C WSG, Green Software Foundation) while Claude Code writes or reviews code: 107 general rules, 137 for 24 languages and frameworks, 13 responsible-use practices, 30 token sobriety rules. Deterministic local audit with file:line, optional hooks, lean mode. Apache-2.0 (code), CC BY 4.0 (rules).

plugins.name: perf-sentinel
plugins.description: Writes performance integration tests that surface N+1, redundant and slow I/O before production, and ranks production findings from Perf Sentinel Hub to fix.
